description: Crop video frame. Cut the frame to the ratio you need — vertical for a feed, square for a post. Nothing is stretched: only the excess is removed. Accepts video/*, .mp4, .mov, .mkv, .webm, .avi, .m4v; up to 500 MB per file.

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

position.description: Which part of the frame to keep

quality.description: Quality: lower number means a better picture and a heavier file

name: video_crop
